meta.title: Moroccan & North African caterer for weddings and events on the French Riviera | L'Orientale du Sud
meta.description: Home-made Moroccan and North African catering on the French Riviera: weddings, henna nights, birthdays, receptions, buffets and table service. Dishes, oriental pastries and fruit cascades to take away or delivered.
meta.orderTitle: Order to take away or for delivery | L'Orientale du Sud
meta.orderDescription: Couscous, tagines, briouats, oriental pastries and fruit cascades to order: pick-up or delivery on the French Riviera, confirmed on WhatsApp.

hero.title: Elegance lies in the details
hero.alt: Two L'Orientale du Sud waiters in black waistcoats present tagines under golden cloches in a white reception hall

manifesto.title: North African cooking, made the way it is at home and served like a feast day
manifesto.text: Everything starts in the kitchen: semolina worked by hand, tagines simmering slowly, brick pastry folded one sheet at a time. We choose our produce ourselves, from suppliers we know, and we cook on the day. Then the team sets the tables, serves your guests and stays by your side until the mint tea.
manifesto.signature: The chef and the whole team

cards.title: Three ways to treat your guests

items.title: Weddings & events
items.text: Buffets, table service, cocktail receptions: we plan the meal with you, from starters to sweets, and the team takes care of everything on the day.

items.title: Take away & delivery
items.text: Couscous, tagines, seffa, platters of savoury bites: enough to feed the family without spending the day in the kitchen, collected or delivered to your door.

items.title: Sweets & fruit cascades
items.text: Gazelle horns, chebakia, trays of oriental pastries and cascades of fresh fruit cut on the day.

weddings.title: Every event is unique, and we prepare it that way
weddings.text: Wedding, henna night, engagement, birthday, family celebration or company reception: we talk it through first, then build a menu that suits you. On the day, the team arrives in uniform, sets up, serves and looks after your guests, always with a smile and a great deal of care.

points.title: Table service
points.text: Our waiters bring the tagines to the table under their golden cloches and serve each guest the way it is done at home, only more polished.

points.title: Buffets
points.text: Moroccan salads, savoury bites, hot dishes and sweets: generous buffets, carefully laid out, indoors or in the open air.

points.title: Fruit cascades
points.text: Fresh fruit chosen and cut on the day, built into a cascade: the centrepiece every guest stops to photograph.

points.title: Tea and the table
points.text: Mint tea poured from on high, tablecloths, drapes and flowers: we also think about the table everything will sit on.

weddings.caption: An open-air reception in the French Riviera sunshine

backstage.title: Before it reaches your table, it all starts here
backstage.text: Choosing the produce, suppliers we know, fresh ingredients. Then hours in the kitchen, smiles and a close-knit team: there is a lot of passion behind every plate.

menu.title: To take away or delivered to you
menu.text: A selection of dishes and sweets we prepare to order. Add what you fancy, choose the day and time slot: the chef confirms every order on WhatsApp before she starts cooking.

team.title: One chef, one team, the same passion
text: Behind L'Orientale du Sud is a chef who cooks the way she was cooked for, with family recipes and family gestures. Around her is a team of waiters you will see from one wedding to the next: they set up, serve, clear and are the last to leave.
2025 was a year full of unforgettable weddings. Thank you to everyone who trusted us, and to everyone who gave their all beside us, in the kitchen and in the dining room.
team.quote: With a smile, passion and the utmost professionalism, our team is by your side.
team.caption: Thank you 2025: the chef, in traditional dress, with the team

ramadan.title: Ramadan tables
ramadan.text: Chebakia, briouats, msemen and dishes for iftar: every year we prepare boxes and menus for breaking the fast with family. Orders open a few weeks before the month begins.
ramadan.message: Hello L'Orientale du Sud, I would like to be told when Ramadan orders open.

zone.title: All along the French Riviera
zone.text: We travel for your weddings and events across the Alpes-Maritimes, from Menton to Cannes and up to Grasse, in reception halls as well as estates and villas. For home delivery, ask us whether your town is covered.
zone.farther: Is your venue further away? Write to us and we will look at it together.
